notes:
STATUTE - KRS 7A.287 "Healthcare transparency dashboard" (statute number confirmed correct). Created 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 179, sec. 17, effective April 14, 2026. URL: https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/law/statutes/statute.aspx?id=57037 (fetched 2026-10-01). Subsection (1): the Commission (LRC), collaborating with the University of Kentucky and the University of Louisville, shall design and develop a web-based dashboard tracking at a minimum (a) leading health indicators; (b) performance indicators for Medicaid managed care organizations; (c) performance indicators for Medicaid-participating providers; (d) performance indicators for the department. Subsection (2), the ONLY enumerated list, applies to MCOs and requires indicators that include but are not limited to: (a) follow-up after emergency department visits; (b) cancer screenings; (c) child and adolescent well-care visits; (d) postpartum care; (e) diabetes care and management; (f) hypertension care and management. The statute names no specific indicators for providers, the department, or leading health indicators. Subsection (3): overseen by a subcommittee of the Medicaid Oversight and Advisory Board established under KRS 7A.283(4); maintained and operated by the Commission. Mapping used in this file: (a) FUA and FUM (FUH added as related); (b) BCS, CCS, COL; (c) WCV (W30 added); (d) PPC postpartum; (e) HBD/GSD; (f) CBP.

KENTUCKY CORE SET COVERAGE. FFY 2025 Core Set is released (CMS file modified 2026-09-22; data as of 2026-04-28 QMR cut). Kentucky reported every KRS-required measure for FFY 2025 EXCEPT breast cancer screening (BCS-AD), colorectal cancer screening (COL-AD) and diabetes glycemic status (GSD-AD, successor to HBD-AD): the 2025 file has no Kentucky rows for them. For each, this file carries the FFY 2024 Kentucky rate (method published, proxyFor set), an FFY 2025 estimate (method estimate), and the MCO HEDIS MY 2024 statewide rate (mco-bcs-e, mco-col-e, mco-gsd-*). Series gaps (KY did not report that year): WCV/W30 FFY 2020 (measures new in 2021), CIS/IMA FFY 2023, IMA FFY 2022, IET FFY 2021, PCR FFY 2020 and 2023, HBD before 2023, COL/OUD/PQI before FFY 2024 (adult Core Set became mandatory in FFY 2024), FUA-CH/FUM-CH before 2022. AAP is not a Core Set measure (MCO HEDIS only). FFY 2025 also adds 65+ strata for FUA/FUM/FUH (KY reported; not loaded here - 18-64 used).

CAUTION - METHODOLOGY BREAK. Kentucky switched from hybrid (chart review) to administrative-only reporting starting FFY 2024 for CIS, IMA, CCS, PPC, CBP and HBD. Large FFY 2023 to 2024 moves (CIS Combo 3 64.1 (FFY22) to 19.2; IMA Combo 1 78.2 (FFY21) to 27.7; HBD >9% 38.1 to 66.4; prenatal 85.5 to 69.0) reflect the method change, not necessarily changes in care. Do not show these series as trends without this caveat; prefer FFY 2024-2025 points for comparison. In FFY 2024 Kentucky also combined separate CHIP with Medicaid for adult measures. Core Set "FFY" = Core Set reporting year; services measured are mostly in the prior calendar year.

CORE SET vs MCO HEDIS. Core Set = Kentucky statewide incl. fee-for-service, administrative method. EQR (IPRO SFY 2025 technical report, final 2026-04-07) = each MCO's audited HEDIS MY 2024 (hybrid/ECDS), managed care only, weighted statewide average. They are not interchangeable (e.g., CIS Combo 3: 49.5% Core Set FFY 2025 vs 72.98% MCO statewide MY 2024). Anthem exited but still has MY 2024 columns; CAHPS excludes Anthem.

TARGETS. No published numeric DMS quality-withhold thresholds were found. Targets attached are the statewide MY 2026 performance targets in the Kentucky Medicaid Quality Strategy (Feb 2024, Table 5, pp. 26-29; 3%/4%/5% annual increases from MY 2020 baseline): https://www.chfs.ky.gov/agencies/dms/dpqo/mco-qb/Documents/2-12-2024%20KY%20Quality%20Strategy.pdf . target.basis is "state quality strategy" - outside the brief's enum (statute|contract|CMS benchmark) because none of those is truthful; the builder may need to allow it. The 2025-2026 MCO contract renewal value-based purchasing (VBP) measures are listed in the FY 2025 Comprehensive Evaluation Summary (pp. 17-18, footnotes 7 and 9): https://www.chfs.ky.gov/agencies/dms/DMSMCOReports/2025%20FY%20Comprehensive%20Evaluation%20Summary.pdf . Core: GSD <8%, PPC postpartum, WCV total, CIS-E Combo 10, IMA-E Combo 2, SNS-E. Bonus pool: APM-E, FUA 7-day, WCC, BCS-E. Core Set measures carry the US state median as comparison only (not a target).

UNITS. PQI rates are admissions per 100,000 beneficiary-months; unit set to "index" because the enum has no per-100k unit. PCR is an observed/expected ratio (lower is better; 1.0 = as expected).
